talks.body: I presented a poster at the European Society for Spatial Biology (ESSB), 2026 for [Human-in-the-loop Characterization of Tissue Microenvironments: From Intensity Averaging to Representation Learning](/posters/CellGalaxy_Poster.pdf) in Sitges, Spain.

Our team received the **Best Poster Award** at the European Society for Spatial Biology (ESSB), 2026 for [Scalable 3D Visualization and Spatial Exploration of Multiplexed Cancer Tissue Images for the Web](/posters/BioSET_Poster.pdf) (I contributed as a collaborator) in Sitges, Spain.
Our paper [PaintCopilot: Modeling Painting as Autonomous Artistic Continuation](https://openreview.net/forum?id=UHbGK6aRSk) was **accepted** to the **NeurIPS Creative AI Track 2026**.
I gave a full paper presentation on [Authoring Data-Driven Chart Animations through Direct Manipulation](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/10742546) at IEEE VIS 2025 in Vienna, Austria.

Our paper [Authoring Data-Driven Chart Animations through Direct Manipulation](https://canisstudio.github.io/CASTPlus/) was **accepted** as a regular paper in **IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics (TVCG)**.
